message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul && grep -RIn "strcpy\|memcpy\|sprintf\|gets\|scanf\|fread\|read(\|malloc\|free\|overflow\|vuln\|bug" . | head -200` executed with exit code 0.

function.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && echo '--- description ---' && cat description.txt && echo '--- repo files ---' && find repo-vul -maxdepth 3 -type f | sed 's#^#/#' | sort | head -200"}
function.name: execute_bash
